notes: Modified cash basis county, governmental funds only. Statement of receipts/disbursements is split over pp4-5 (General/Road/Inheritance on p4; Bridge/Other/Total on p5); amounts from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Fund balances recorded as fund balance (beginning 3,229,148, ending 3,662,717, p7); ending cash = Cash and Deposits 3,662,717 (p7); beginning cash not printed (null). Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement Total column (pp6-7; totals equal the government-wide statement p1). Detail: Schedule 1 (General Fund by department and object, actual columns on pp8-16; the even pages carry only the 2021 comparative column) and Schedule 2 (special revenue funds by fund, pp17-21); Schedules 3-5 (pp23-26) repeat these figures and Schedule 6 (p27) is tax collections; not recorded. Zero-actual lines (budget only) omitted. Transfers printed inside schedule totals (General Fund Miscellaneous 'Transfers' 1,270,000, Road 'Transfers' 150,000, Inheritance Tax 'Transfers' 200,000, Bridge receipts 'Transfers' 1,620,000) are other financing lines with includes on the totals. Single-line funds without a printed fund total have no detail_totals entry. 'Local' lines are context labels and stay other; the Statement of Activities charges for services per function are noted on each line. Intergovernmental Receipts kept as one statement line (as in FY2023); the schedules show it includes Federal 1,825,718 (General 21, Bridge 1,639,326, COVID 186,371). Read pages 1-27 of 27
